what: What is stopping us, in plain words. Hand-written because a machine cannot say who is waiting on whom. A blocker that clears is DELETED, not marked done.

blockers.what: The product cannot use a fact even when we hand it one
blockers.why: We tested what would happen if we knew perfectly what each founder's money was for — the strongest thing we know of for telling two near-identical funds apart. Nothing moved. Fifty-nine of our own rules turn on that field and not one verdict changed. Until that is fixed, asking founders a better question buys nothing, and a paid test would be measuring a product that cannot act on its own inputs.
blockers.ask: Nothing. Being fixed now, and it is the reason the paid test is waiting.

blockers.what: One test, held back on purpose
blockers.why: You asked for every free improvement to land first, and that is right — a test run against a product we are mid-way through fixing tells us less than the same test run after. Three fixes are in flight across the shortlist, the ranking and the write-up. The test itself is ready and its safety conditions are now provable.
blockers.ask: Nothing yet. I will come back for the 15 euros when the free work is done, with what changed.

blockers.what: One deployment still needs you, and only that
blockers.why: The data corrections are being applied now under the go-ahead you gave. What I am not doing on my own is redeploying the pipeline container: it is 316 commits behind, carries six days of unreviewed changes, and its safety check has never once published a result. That is a deploy, not a data fix, and it should be a deliberate decision.
